items.question: Can I try Indlio for free?
items.answer: Yes! Our Free plan lets you create one booking page and accept unlimited bookings. No credit card required.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades take effect at the end of your billing period.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and UPI payments.

seo.title: About — Indlio
seo.description: Indlio is building simple appointment scheduling software for small and growing businesses.

about.title: Simple appointment scheduling for small businesses
about.subtitle: We're building booking software that makes it easy for businesses to accept appointments and let customers book themselves.

problem.title: Appointment scheduling shouldn't be complicated
paragraphs: Too many small businesses still manage appointments through messages, phone calls, and spreadsheets. It's time-consuming and error-prone.
Existing booking software is either too simple to be useful, or too complex to set up. Small businesses need something in between.
problem.quote: Make appointment scheduling simple enough to set up in minutes, powerful enough to grow with your business.

workflow.title: From setup to booked in minutes
workflow.subtitle: Indlio makes it easy to start accepting bookings without complicated setup.

who.subtitle: Whatever you do, Indlio makes it easier to accept bookings.

opportunity.title: Simple booking software that works
opportunity.body: Indlio gives you everything you need to manage appointments—booking pages, calendar sync, reminders, and payments—without the complexity of enterprise software.

founders.title: Meet the founder
founders.subtitle: Indlio was started to solve a simple problem: appointment scheduling is too complicated for small businesses.

people.name: Valliyappan
people.body: Valliyappan is building Indlio to make appointment scheduling simple for small and growing businesses. After seeing countless businesses struggle with complicated booking software, he knew there had to be a better way.
